citations.sql: SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.color, p.unit_price, p.material, p.armrests, p.weight_rating_lb, s.depot_id, s.depot_name, s.available, t.days FROM products p JOIN stock_available s USING (sku) JOIN delivery_times t ON t.depot_id = s.depot_id AND t.destination_city = 'Chicago' WHERE p.category = 'Office chairs' AND p.color = 'Navy' AND LOWER(p.material) LIKE '%mesh%' AND p.armrests = '4D' AND p.unit_price <= 300.0 AND s.available >= 40
